title: Databricks profile URI auth must pass the profile to the SDK Config, not only the host
answers: Codex tracing with databricks://<profile> uses the wrong Databricks account
databricks:// profile ignores my CLI profile when several profiles share one workspace
MLflow Databricks auth picks the wrong token for my profile
databricks auth token called with --host instead of --profile
body:
Symptom: With tracking URI `databricks://<profile>`, requests authenticate as a different Databricks CLI identity when several CLI profiles target the same workspace host.
Root cause: libs/typescript/core/src/auth/index.ts:createDatabricksAuth built the SDK `Config` with `host: options.host`, so the SDK resolved credentials by host (`databricks auth token --host`) instead of by the selected profile.
Fix pattern: Pass the host already resolved from the profile (`host`) into `Config`, and keep `profile` set in the same Config so the SDK runs `databricks auth token --profile <name>`.
Constraints: Applies to any code that builds a Databricks SDK Config from a profile URI. Do not drop the `profile` field or substitute host-only config. Regression coverage uses a fake CLI binary in libs/typescript/core/tests/core/auth.test.ts that asserts the `auth token --profile` call and rejects `--host`.
applies: Databricks auth resolution in @mlflow/core (createAuthProvider) and any integration that relies on it.
says: Tracking with a named workspace profile logs in under the wrong user identity.
Requests authenticate with the wrong credentials when multiple profiles share a workspace.
Logging to a workspace should strictly respect the chosen connection profile.
Connecting with a configured profile erroneously uses another account on that host.
search: Databricks auth configuration in libs/typescript/core/src/auth/index.ts:createDatabricksAuth must retain the profile property alongside host in SDK Config. Omitting profile causes the SDK to invoke databricks auth token --host instead of --profile, selecting the wrong CLI identity when multiple profiles target the same workspace. Tested via fake CLI assertions in libs/typescript/core/tests/core/auth.test.ts.
